source.text: 20. An Amendment To Be Offered by Representative Roy of Texas or a Designee, Debatable for 10 Minutes At the end of the bill (before the short title), insert the following: Sec. __. None of the funds appropriated or otherwise made available by this Act may be made available to the United Nations.
